body:
This is a giant-sized bumblebee, much larger than its normal sized counterpart.

Giant Bumblebee, Queen
CR 5

XP 1,600
N Large vermin
Init +2; Senses darkvision 60 ft., tremorsense 60 ft.; Perception +5

DEFENSE

AC 18, touch 11, flat-footed 16 (+2 Dex, +7 natural, -1 size)
hp 52 (8d8+16)
Fort +8; Ref +4; Will +3
Immune mind-affecting effects

OFFENSE

Speed 20 ft., fly 60 ft. (good)
Melee sting +9 (2d6+7 plus poison)
Space 10 ft.; Reach 5 ft.

STATISTICS

Str 20, Dex 14, Con 14, Int —, Wis 13, Cha 11
Base Atk +5; CMB +11; CMD 23 (+32 vs. trip)
Skills Fly +4, Perception +5, Survival +1 (+5 to keep from getting lost); Racial Modifiers +4 Perception, +4 Survival to keep from getting lost

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Poison (Ex)

Sting—injury; save Fortitude DC 16; frequency 1/round for 6 rounds; effect 1d4 Con; cure 1 save. The save DC is Constitution-based.

ECOLOGY

Environment temperate forests and plains
Organization solitary, buzz (2–5), or hive (11–20)
Treasure none
